nodes.title: Note: how to use
widgets_values:
## ALL in ONE MiniMax H3

One node, the whole H3 pipeline. There is no graph to wire: pick a **mode** in the tab bar,
fill the boxes, press **Generate**. The node builds the real workflow behind the scenes and
queues it, then shows the clip inline with its audio.

### Modes that run here

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| **T2V** | Text to video with native audio (voice, room tone, music in the same pass) |
| **I2V** | Animate a start frame, optionally morph to an end frame |
| **R2V** | Reference images / video / audio drive the clip |
| **Keyframes** | Pin stills at chosen frame positions |
| **Extend** | Continue an existing clip |
| **Chain** | Multi-clip continuation through H3 Motion Context (latent path, no re-encode) |


**Image**, **Audio Drive** and the **Upscale** hooks are in the tab bar but not installed. Image
mode makes stills, not video — I2V above is the image-to-video one — and it needs 12.9 GB of extra
prompt models nobody generating video would use. Audio Drive's pack compiles llama-cpp-python and
pulls voxcpm, demucs and torchcodec on every launch; RTX Video Super Resolution needs a consumer
RTX card and will not run on a data-centre GPU. Selecting either shows
*Node not found* — that is the missing pack, not a broken graph.

### Prompt shape

H3 reads three labelled sections, in this order:

```
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic live-action. <subject, setting, light, the action start to finish>.

overall_soundscape:
<1-4 sentences: ambience, physical action sounds, non-verbal human sounds>

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

The **Discover** tab ships this as fill-in templates per mode — start there rather than from an
empty box. Dialogue goes inside the description as `(S1) <character> speaks: <d>[English] line</d>`.
Multi-shot cuts are written inline: `The shot cuts to [Shot 2] At 00:02.000 ...`.

### Quality

The **Quality** dropdown ships on **Balanced** (SolAttn, 30 steps) — installed and working.
**Native** (30 steps, no accelerator) always works. For **Speed**, switch the **H3 Cache** chip
off first: that pack calls a function ComfyUI core removed in August 2026 and is deliberately not
installed, so leaving the chip on fails the Run. Speed's other half (SolAttn at 20 steps) is fine.
**Turbo** (6 steps) and **High Quality** (40 steps, SageAttention via KJNodes) are both installed.
Turbo's LoRA is downloaded and preselected, so it works on the first Run — High Quality additionally needs the `sageattention` package present in
the image, so if it errors, fall back to Balanced.

If **R2V** throws `shape mismatch: value tensor of shape [...] cannot be broadcast`, that is a
known ComfyUI core bug on H3 reference video, not your inputs and not the reference count — use
T2V or I2V, and report it so the template can move to a newer image. T2V and I2V are unaffected.

**Live Preview** (the toggle under the video) is on and works — the clip plays in the preview box
while it samples, so a bad take can be cancelled early instead of paid for in full. It costs some
generation speed; the dropdown beside it trades preview smoothness against that, and turning it
off is the fastest setting.

Resolution presets run 608x352 through 1344x768 landscape, plus five vertical ones added for short-form: 352x608, 480x864, 544x960, **576x1024 (exact 9:16)** and 768x1344. Draft vertical at 352x608 or 480x864, finish at 576x1024. Longer and larger cost VRAM and time; a clip
tops out at H3's per-generation ceiling, which is what **Extend** and **Chain** exist to get past.

### Where the output goes

Clips save to the bucket root as `h3_00001_.mp4`, `h3_00002_.mp4` — flat, so the storage API's
`listFiles` can see them and you can download a finished clip without opening ComfyUI. The save
counter never overwrites. **Chain** is the exception: it writes into `chain/<session>/`, a
subfolder `listFiles` does not list, so pull those from the node's **Library** tab before you
stop the service.

History, favourites and settings live in `user/default/` inside the bucket, so they survive a
stop and come back on the next launch with the same bucket.

nodes.title: Note: models & node packs
widgets_values:
## Models

This template downloads its own weights on first start — **59.8 GB** total, into the bucket:

```
models/
├── diffusion_models/
│   ├── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors    19.5 GB   T2V / I2V / keyframes / extend
│   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors   19.5 GB   R2V / chain
├── text_encoders/
│   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors        14.6 GB
├── vae/
│   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors                4.9 GB
│   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors                0.6 GB
├── vae_approx/
│   └── taeh3.safetensors                                    9.3 MB   Live Preview decoder
└── loras/
    └── minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors          0.7 GB   Turbo preset
```

The LoRA is only used by the Turbo preset, and it is preselected for you — the pack ships its
`speed_lora` setting empty, and the launch script fills it in, so Turbo works without a trip to
Settings.

The one node builds its graph at queue time, so — unlike the other templates here — there are no
loader nodes in this canvas to carry the URLs. They are listed here instead, and the launch
script reads them off this note. The names match the pack's own defaults, so the node finds them
with no configuration:

- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)
- [taeh3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/resolve/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora/resolve/main/minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors) — Turbo preset

Both diffusion models are fetched because the mode tabs switch between them freely. Only one is
resident per generation.

## Node packs

Cloned on launch, all pure Python (no pip step): the
[ALL-in-ONE node](https://github.com/LeonQ8/ComfyUI-ALLinONE-MinimaxH3) itself,
[H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef](https://github.com/seitanism/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef)
for keyframes / extend / chain, and
[SolAttn_triton](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton) for the Balanced and Speed
quality presets, [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) for Live Preview and the High
Quality preset's SageAttention, [MiniMax-H3-Turbo](https://github.com/Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo)
for the Turbo preset. KJNodes is the only one with dependencies, so it reinstalls its five pip packages on
each launch from a wheel cache in the bucket.

`ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Cache` is **not** installed, and is deleted on launch if an earlier one left it
behind: it calls `time_shift_slope`, which ComfyUI core removed on 2026-08-06, and it patches the
model at import — so having it present fails every generation, not just the preset that uses it.
